actions: Read .antfarm/queen.md, GOAL.md and DECISIONS.md, then inspected open Issues, open PRs and CI status via gh

Reviewed PR #30 (feat(i18n): translate runtime strings in app.js and state.js to pt-BR) against Issue #27's 13 acceptance criteria, including the full app.js/state.js/DECISIONS.md diff and the tests/app.spec.js diff
Weighed the external Codex review (no issues found) against the acceptance criteria
Approved PR #30 with a per-criterion review comment and squash-merged it; Issue #27 closed automatically
Commented on parked Issue #28 confirming its precondition (slices 1 and 2 merged) is now met, and added the 'ready' label

agent_report.summary:
Reviewed and merged PR #30, which translates every runtime-produced string in `app.js` and `state.js` to pt-BR. All 13 acceptance criteria of Issue #27 are satisfied: accessible status text, delete accessible names and the `window.confirm` message asserted on the dialog itself, the Unfinished summary at 0/1/2 items with correct Portuguese inflection, `Ontem`, `Concluir`/`Trazer para este dia` with distinct aria-labels, week progress, `Esta semana`/`Semana de …`, `Hoje`/`Vendo`, fixed-clock deadline urgency labels, an accented literal so a broken encoding fails, no test deleted or loosened (73 to 74 tests), and the 360px no-horizontal-scroll check plus a new clipping check on the longer pt-BR button. The Worker additionally found a string the Issue's list had missed (the week-strip day button's aria-label suffix) by grepping as instructed, and recorded it in `DECISIONS.md`. The external Codex review reported no issues, so there was nothing to weigh against the criteria. Issue #27 closed on merge.

With work in flight back to zero, I labelled parked Issue #28 `ready` — slice 3 of 3 of the pt-BR translation: passing `'pt-BR'` explicitly to all five `toLocaleDateString` calls, `dd/mm/aaaa` numeric dates, week-strip weekday abbreviations that stay distinguishable (pt-BR `narrow` gives three ambiguous pairs), and the English-guard test. Its precondition, slices 1 and 2 merged, is now met; I said so in a comment. Its acceptance criteria were already written and needed no change. Issue #22 (Commitments add-form button stretching at 360px) stays parked for its turn rather than being duplicated, since `ready_max` is 1.

The project is not DONE: the deployed interface still shows English dates and ambiguous weekday letters, so `GOAL.md`'s requirement that the whole interface be in Brazilian Portuguese has no supporting evidence yet. No DONE Issue was created.
